(515516)na mo bka' lcog mthar dril bsil/badzra yakṣa la/dril bcas/gu mor gadzub srin sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/a mṛ ta la thod rgya lta bu/swa

tei:div.tei:p: dril bsil/ badzra yakṣa la/ dril bcas/ gu mor gadzub srin sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ a mṛ ta la thod rgya lta bu/ swa bhā wa thal mo khang stong*/ mchod rdzas nas/ gar bskor/ rdor gser/ dril bu bsil nas bcad/ dus ji srid la/ rdo rje mtheb mdzub bar du bzung bcol/ dril bu ring dkrol// pu ra la pad skor cha tshangs/ se ge la med pa'i arghaṃ sogs rang rgya/ mthar/ rdor dril bsor/ mchod rol/ gnas/ sngags/ bhrum̐ mchod do la/ pad skor cha tshangs/ sman raka gtor gsum rang rgya/ rdor gsor dril bsil/ mchod rol/ tshul khrims dri ldan la/ pad skor cha tshang*/ bdug spos rang rgya/ rdor gsor dril bsil/ de las gzhan yang rang gdangs/ gaṇḍe ring dkrol/ mchod rol/ ma lus sems can la 'jug go mnyam med gtsug gi rgyan gcig kaḥdam pa// kun tu 'od kyi sa brnyes gtsang ston pa// thams cad mkhyen dngos dpal ldan byams pa 'bum// bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bsod nams 'bum// bskyed rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin ye shes 'bum// bsad gso'i brtul zhugs grub pa byang chub 'bum// bstan pa'i sgron me gsum la gsol ba 'debs// dus gsum mkhyen brtse o rgyan bi ma la'i// gsang mdzod thugs kyi dpal be'u kha phyes nas// zab gsang snyan brgyud skal ldan 'gro la spel// klong gsal snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phyag bris las zhal bshus// dge'o//
